channel.title: Prediction Markets Daily
channel.description:
The prediction-market ecosystem in Canada, the United States and the world, every day: the regulators, the courts and the new rules; the venues, the markets they list and the people building them; the most traded questions of the day with their prices, volumes and caveats; and one clear explainer on how these markets work and what the research says. Journalism and education — never a tip, never a bet.
AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

item.title: Ep 4: Two states won the right to regulate Kalshi sports contracts as gambling.
item.description: Prediction Markets Daily Two states won the right to regulate Kalshi sports contracts as gambling. What You Need to Know: A federal appeals court has held that Kalshi's sports contracts are not financial swaps, and that Ohio and Tennessee may regulate them under state gambling laws. Kalshi has also suspended three congressional candidates who bet on their own races, while Missouri's attorney general ordered six prediction markets to stop sports bets. ...
